connection_type.description: Possible values:`Directly`, `PrivateLink`, `SshTunnel`. `SshTunnel` is used as a value if this parameter is omitted in the request and any of the following parameter's values is specified: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, `tunnel_user`. Otherwise, `Directly` is used as a value if the parameter is omitted.

entra_app_id.description: Registered Application ID (for Entra ID authentication).

entra_tenant_id.description: Azure Tenant ID (for Entra ID authentication).

host.description: DB instance host or IP address.

replication_slot.description: Replication slot name. Specify only for `"updated_method": "WAL_PGOUTPUT"`.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

update_method.description:
The method to detect new or changed rows.
Specify only for `"service": "postgres"` or `"service": "postgres_rds"`.
Supported values:
`WAL_PGOUTPUT` - logical replication of the WAL using the pgoutput plugin. This method replicates new, changed, and deleted rows by tailing the write-ahead log (WAL) using a logical slot. This is more efficient than the query-based method, but requires more setup and monitoring.
`QUERY_BASED` - this method replicates new, changed and deleted rows via the `xmin` and `ctid` system columns

password.description: ESM key for the user's password.

user.description: ESM key for the user name.
